name: Chetan Sharma
player_statement:
A complete player, Chetan Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 4 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 33, with an average of 16.50 and a quick strike rate of 286.96. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 6 sixes and 6 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 16.0 overs, taking 2 wickets at an economy rate of 8.56. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
